property.description: Welcome to this classic Midtown Terrace home, thoughtfully updated for modern living while retaining its timeless San Francisco charm. This inviting two-bedroom, one-bath residence features a beautifully updated kitchen and bathroom, new flooring throughout, and fresh interior paint, creating a bright, clean and move-in-ready atmosphere. The comfortable floor plan offers well-proportioned living spaces and an easy connection to the homes good-sized backyardperfect for entertaining, gardening, relaxing outdoors, or creating your own urban retreat. A large attached garage provides generous parking, storage and additional possibilities. Ideally situated in desirable Midtown Terrace, the home enjoys a wonderfully convenient central San Francisco location with easy access to West Portal, Noe Valley, Glen Park, Forest Hill and the Castro, as well as nearby shopping, dining, parks and recreation. Convenient access to Muni and major commuter routes makes getting around the city or heading south equally easy. Freshly updated, exceptionally well located and filled with classic appeal, this Midtown Terrace home offers a wonderful opportunity to enjoy comfortable San Francisco living in one of the citys most centrally situated residential neighborhoods.

tools.name: Rental search
tools.description: Discovery of rentals by area and filters; pass next_cursor back as cursor for later pages. Use rental for one listing and building for one apartment community.

options.name: available_by
options.about: Requested move-in date (YYYY-MM-DD) passed to Zillow's availability filter. Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

options.name: cursor
options.about: next_cursor from a previous page (`<regionId>:<regionType>:<page>`, pages 2-20). Location text is not re-resolved when a cursor is given.

options.name: furnished
options.about: true restricts to furnished rentals; false/null does not filter.

options.name: home_types
options.about: Restrict to these Zillow rental types; omit for all types.

options.name: location
options.about: City, zip, neighborhood, county or state text resolved through Zillow autocomplete, or an explicit Zillow region as `<regionId>:<regionType>` (e.g. `37607:17` for Brooklyn).

options.name: max_rent
options.about: Maximum monthly rent in whole USD.

options.name: min_rent
options.about: Minimum monthly rent in whole USD.

options.name: pets
options.about: Require listings that allow each of these pet kinds.

options.name: sort
options.about: relevance = Zillow priorityscore, rent_low/rent_high = monthly payment, newest = days on Zillow.

tools.name: Search
tools.description: Find for-sale listings in a region or a map box. Chain from locations: pass its region_id (or region_ids[0]) as region_id and its region_types[0] / region_subtype as region_type; bounds are then optional and the response's pages[].region.bounds carries the region's box for map or a narrower search. Alternatively supply bounds as {west, east, south, north} in longitude/latitude degrees. Rental listings are not supported by this search.

options.name: bounds
options.about: Map bounding box {west, east, south, north} in longitude/latitude degrees, west < east and south < north, at most 10 degrees per axis. Optional when region_id is given: the search then covers the whole region and returns its box in pages[].region.bounds.

options.name: region_id
options.about: Zillow region identifier: a locations result's region_id or region_ids[0]. Sufficient on its own; with bounds it narrows the box to the region.

options.name: region_type
options.about: Region type as the numeric Zillow code (2 state, 4 county, 6 city, 7 zipcode, 8 neighborhood) or the matching region_types / region_subtype string returned by locations. Only pass with region_id.

response.about: For-sale listings ordered by relevance, one to three pages per call. Map/building results and relaxed matches stay separate.

tools.name: Zori
tools.description: Market-level rent index questions (median asking rent over time, YoY rent change for a metro/city/county/ZIP). Not for individual listings: use rental_search, rental or building for those. Resolve ambiguous names with the state (`Springfield, IL`) or pass the Zillow RegionID.

options.name: from
options.about: Earliest month to return (YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD, compared by month). Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}(-[0-9]{2})?$.

options.name: region
options.about: Region name with state (`San Francisco, CA`), a metro name as published (`San Francisco, CA`), a ZIP code, `United States` (metro file), or a Zillow RegionID.

options.name: region_type
options.about: ZORI geography file: metro (MSAs plus the United States row), city, county or zip. Zillow publishes no neighborhood ZORI file.

options.name: seasonally_adjusted
options.about: Read the seasonally adjusted (`_sa`) file variant.

options.name: series
options.about: sfrcondomfr = all homes (single-family, condo and multifamily), sfr = single-family, mfr = multifamily.

options.name: to
options.about: Latest month to return (YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD, compared by month). latest and the derived changes refer to the last non-null month inside the bounds. Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}(-[0-9]{2})?$.

response.about: Zillow Observed Rent Index (ZORI) monthly time series for one metro, city, county or ZIP from Zillow Research's public CSV exports: typical asking rent in USD per month, smoothed, optionally seasonally adjusted, with latest value and month-over-month / year-over-year change.

fields.name: count
fields.about: Number of points returned (months inside the requested bounds, missing months included as null).

fields.name: latest
fields.about: Last non-null point inside the requested bounds; null when none.

fields.name: mom_change
fields.about: Change from the month before `latest`; null when either value is missing.

fields.name: source_last_modified
fields.about: The file host's Last-Modified header, as sent.

fields.name: yoy_change
fields.about: Change from twelve months before `latest`; null when either value is missing.
